title: PhysioNet wearable protocol representation
research_question: Can the externally recorded protocol stages of the wearable stress and exercise dataset be represented as declared occurrences, with the physiological signals and self-reports joined to them as measurements, without the system inferring any stage or any stress from the signals?
data_source: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions, version 1.0.1, DOI 10.13026/he0v-tf17, https://physionet.org/content/wearable-device-dataset/1.0.1/; the STRESS cohort directories with tags.csv, HR.csv, EDA.csv, TEMP.csv and Stress_Level files.
time_semantics: Observations are placed on a regular one-second timeline; each row is the interval that starts at its timestamp and is closed on the left.
preprocessing_steps: signals are kept at their native sampling rates
time outside a declared protocol stage is labelled unassigned
object_definition: One row of the result is one declared protocol occurrence for one subject: a stage from its tag boundary to the next.
validations: exact boundaries at the tag timestamps
every occurrence joined to exactly one self-report
native-rate coverage of every signal within every occurrence
provenance: approved contract fingerprint and the approving authority

exclusions.reason: duplicated raw signals documented by the dataset authors
PPG and temperature sensors covered by the protection dock
protocol split across f14_a and f14_b after Bluetooth loss

claim_limits: protocol states and their boundaries are externally declared
FeatureGraph does not infer stress from physiological signals
the study does not establish causality or physiological validity
